ruleDefinitions.name: Privilege Escalation via Named Pipe Impersonation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a remote file copy attempt to a hidden network share. This may indicate lateral movement or data staging activity.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe" OR process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*echo.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\\\\.\\\\pipe\\\\.*")))
